en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari, that he said: I was told by Muhammed bin Isa bin Ubaid al-Yaqteeni, that he said: I was told by Yunus bin Abdul-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from al-Sadiq, Ja’far bin Muhammed, peace be upon them both, that he said:

Indeed, for Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, are three sanctities which there is nothing like: His Book, which is His Wisdom and Light; His House that He made a destination for the people, by which He accepts no orientation from anyone except (that it is performed) towards it; and the Family of your Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family.
